sentences.text: Social worker Hannah Price from Harbridge children's services conducted the assessment.
The assessment was triggered because Millie told her teacher she did not want to go home on Monday.
Present at the assessment: Stacey Lambert (mother), Millie Lambert (child, aged 9), and the mother's stepfather Craig.
Family composition: Stacey, Millie, Craig (Millie's stepfather), and Jayden (2 years old).
Craig is Millie's stepfather; the couple has been together for four years.
Millie's biological father is in Scotland and she sees him during summer holidays.
The landlord is slow to fix damp in Millie's room.
Millie has a hamster named Biscuit in her room.
Millie is in Year Four, plays in the netball team, and likes art.
Millie stated that Jayden takes her pens.
Millie reported that she does not wet the bed.
Stacey stated that Millie has not seen anyone about the bedwetting.
Stacey stated that she thought Millie would grow out of the bedwetting.
Millie reported that Craig hits her with a belt on her legs and the back of her legs when she wets the bed.
Millie reported that Craig hits her every time she wets the bed.
Millie reported that the last incident occurred on Sunday morning before her mother got up.
Millie reported that the belt marks were red lines that went away.
Millie stated that no one else at home hurts her.
Millie stated that her mother never hits her and gives her cuddles.
Stacey stated that Craig gives Millie a smack with his belt now and again on her legs.
Stacey stated that she has only seen Craig hit Millie once or twice.
Stacey stated that Craig is from a strict family.
Stacey stated that she has told Craig to stop hitting Millie.
Stacey stated that the incident is not abuse.
Social worker Hannah Price stated that hitting a child with a belt is not acceptable and she must act on it.
Social worker Hannah Price stated that she is going to speak to her manager and the police today (strategy discussion).
Social worker Hannah Price requested that Craig stay away from the house until further notice.
Stacey agreed to ring Craig's brother on Canal Street to have him stay there tonight.
Social worker Hannah Price stated that she might ask a paediatrician to see Millie.
Stacey works mornings at Greggs; Craig works full time on the bins.
